cache_group_rule: cache_group is the full model_hash; rows with the same value are one reuse group and must be colocated in one shard

cache_key_components.key_material: key_material = {"format": "v6-scg-cache", "format_version": 2, "model_hash": <sha256 hex>, "source_sha": <executed commit sha>, "scg_builder_sha": <sha256 of src/scg/builder.py bytes>, "semantics_version": "v6-strong-time-1", "python": "3.13", "serialization": "json-fraction-v2"}

cache_policy.atomic_write: write a temporary file then atomically replace the entry
cache_policy.corruption_policy: any deserialization or validation failure downgrades to miss
cache_policy.directory: cache directory is given by environment variable SCG_CACHE_DIR; the workflow sets SCG_CACHE_DIR=${{ runner.temp }}/scg_cache
cache_policy.disabled_policy: when the cache is disabled the status is "disabled"
cache_policy.entry: one single file <cache_key>.json per cached SCG
cache_policy.oversize_policy: an entry larger than 64 MiB is not written; the cell keeps status "miss" and the provenance records reason "entry_too_large" with store_ok=false

provenance_schema.hit: {cache_status: hit, key, key_material, reason: verified, load_s, build_s: null, store_s: null, payload_sha256, file_bytes, serializer}
provenance_schema.miss: {cache_status: miss, key, key_material, reason: stored | store_error:* | entry_too_large:*, store_ok, build_s, load_s: 0.0, store_s, payload_sha256, file_bytes, serializer}
provenance_schema.required_key_material: format, format_version, model_hash, source_sha, scg_builder_sha, semantics_version, python, serialization

expected_cache.basis: Each family shard executes, in CSV order: the cold default model at L_low, the same model at L_mid, the same model at L_high_complete, and a replicate of the L_low cell. The first row builds the SCG (miss) and the next three reuse the same model_hash cache entry (hit). The three WIP bound cells and the difficult cell each introduce a distinct model (miss). Hence 5 misses and 3 hits per shard, 60/36 overall.

experiment_definitions.B_wip: same structural family at WIP bounds 1/2/3, each a cold model
experiment_definitions.C_Lsweep: same default model at three structural L bounds plus one replica of the cold (L_low, first) cell
experiment_definitions.D_difficult: Pilot-defined difficult parameter cell, a cold model

identity_rule: bounded_problem_id hashes {protocol, model_hash, L, H}; configuration_id hashes the bounded-problem payload plus mode and replicate; task_id equals configuration_id
selection_rule: 12 declared benchmark families x 8 preregistered structural strata; one sha256-derived deterministic seed per family; the family order is FAMILY_SPECS order. WIP cells are selected by a deterministic combination of n_parts and wip_bound (see wip_structure_rule), never by any observed result. No Pilot verdict, runtime, completion status, or prior result influences task selection.
shard_planning_rule: one shard per benchmark family (12 shards x 8 tasks); every task with the same expected model_hash is placed in the same shard, i.e. the same worker; within each shard the CSV and execution order is fixed so the first row of a cache group is the cold build and all later rows of that group reuse it
wip_structure_rule: wip_parts = max(3, parts + 1); ensures WIP models are distinct from the default L-sweep model so the pre-registered miss/hit invariant holds
